title: Bentov's mysterious death in a plane crash

as_told.title: Bentov killed in American Airlines Flight 191 crash

plain: Itzhak Bentov, the author of a book called Stalking the Wild Pendulum, died in a plane crash in 1979, a death Michels presents as part of a pattern of scientists lost under strange circumstances. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source, in two episodes. In the later one he gives the details: Bentov was 55 when American Airlines Flight 191 crashed soon after taking off from Chicago's O'Hare airport.
